why: cloud relay-chat runs the start-session harness login step before the relay send (Leo: "we have the daemon, we have the token, we have the thing that can just send it over the authentication ... just fix it"). The App part is the binding over App-only types (AppActionContext, CloudHandlers, CloudStartSession, CloudMachineSession.harnessLogin): the login step before relay.chat/relay.answer, its 15 s share of the result deadline, the typed undelivered refusals and their three localized strings; the login rules stay in Rust (cmux-cloud-start-core) and CmuxNextCloudCredentials, the relay stream in CmuxNextCloud.
